sentence: This project studies how a type of artificial intelligence can find the properties of faults that cause earthquakes to slip.
This project builds courses and a tool that uses a large language model to match course syllabi to national competency standards.
This project studies how systems with several interacting objectives reach a stable outcome and builds methods that work for large machine learning problems.
This project builds a tool on a single silicon chip for imaging human tissue in real time.
This project builds tools that label tiny membrane-bound particles released by cells so researchers can see where they go, including between plants and a fungal pathogen.
This project tries to find out which part of semicrystalline polymers generates electricity when they are compressed or stretched.
This project studies how harvesting balsa wood from rainforests affects forest species, their chemical interactions and nearby indigenous communities.
This project builds robots that reason about what people know and expect so they can work safely with human partners.
This project builds artificial intelligence tools that pull more information from radar data to better understand and predict precipitation and storms.
This project studies how forest fires change the microbes and carbon in deep soils and around tree roots.
This project builds quantum memories that protect fragile quantum information by using symmetries in their design and in how errors are decoded.
This project builds a tiny platform that uses laser particles as barcodes on polymer beads to test chemical compounds for drug discovery.
This project builds a portable device that uses an artificial molecule called an aptamer to detect foodborne bacterial pathogens in food manufacturing facilities.
This project studies how machine learning can help a computer program find the shortest route in more complex pathfinding problems.
This project builds methods that use quantum computing to improve the design of multi-material structures through topology optimization.
This project uses sediment cores from the ocean to study how patterns of rainfall, wind and temperature in the tropical ocean changed in the past.
This project builds Monte Carlo methods that find the inputs needed to generate a desired outcome in simulations of physical phenomena.
This project builds deep learning models for medical imaging that keep working when the environment, device or population changes.
